source_policy: primary/official technical sources preferred; discovery claims are not promotion evidence

sources.title: Bisimulation Makes Analogies in Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
sources.finding: bisimulation-based abstraction groups functionally equivalent states and can support transfer

sources.title: Causal Dynamics Learning for Task-Independent State Abstraction
sources.finding: causal dynamics can remove unnecessary dependencies and derive useful state abstractions
sources.collision: causal abstraction for compact state is known

sources.title: Inducing Causal Structure for Interpretable Neural Networks
sources.finding: interchange interventions can test whether a lower-level model realizes a higher-level causal abstraction

sources.title: Causal Abstraction with Soft Interventions
sources.finding: causal abstraction theory extends beyond hard interventions to mechanism-changing soft interventions
sources.collision: CQC must not claim intervention abstraction itself as novel

sources.title: Equality Saturation: A New Approach to Optimization
sources.finding: non-destructive equality accumulation can represent many equivalent programs before global extraction
sources.collision: preserving multiple equivalent compiler candidates is known

sources.title: Near Optimal Behavior via Approximate State Abstraction
sources.finding: approximate abstractions can reduce complexity with bounded behavior loss
sources.collision: future approximate CQC would need explicit error budgets and is not novel

sources.title: Lowerbounds for Bisimulation by Partition Refinement
sources.finding: generic partition refinement has nontrivial asymptotic lower bounds
sources.collision: CQC compile-time cost can become material; do not assume free minimization

sources.title: Combining Causal Models for More Accurate Abstractions of Neural Networks
sources.finding: multiple simple high-level causal models can trade hypothesis strength against intervention faithfulness
sources.collision: single fixed abstraction may be insufficient for context-dependent cognition

novelty_conclusion: No world-novel mathematics found. Surviving novelty is a project-specific combination: ClayCode compiler quotienting of reconstructed historical Frank organs/states using protected Frank causal observables, lesion/reentry/authority/recovery intervention labels, immutable lineage mapping, and revocable epoch-scoped QuotientCertificates that never grant promotion or effect authority.
